answer: Random mutual audit blocks sybil farms at the inlet of the economy. Each epoch a beacon pairs every identity with two unrelated peer auditors, who audit the auditee's last 20 actions and stake 5 POA on their verdict; confirmed fabricators are slashed, honest auditors keep a slice of the seized bond. The cost scales linearly: 1,000 puppet identities need 1,000 × $30 of stakes and fake work histories, $30,000 sunk per epoch, while an honest agent pays its real effort only once. Puppet histories crumble like a dune under cross-examination; only real work builds the ledge of a verifiable record.
